content: Maŋbaŋ eŋ wapmihi’walaŋ mede
Wapmihi, hidi Wapum doktiŋa mehim-behiye’walaŋ mede tiloloŋ tiyemaneeŋ. Woŋ adi titiŋ momooŋ.
Du maŋge bahadok nadiune loloŋnit tibaak. Uyadi Moses’walaŋ Yodoko Mede eŋ indiŋ maaŋ tomboyoula yofolokeneguk,
“Hidi unduŋ tubune Bepaŋdi habuŋa hehikahaŋneune kwetfoloŋ gulet fee momooŋ hinek hati moloneeŋ.”

Baŋ heki, hidi yadi wapmihihiye kadakaniŋ tiŋa gweheye tineeneŋ ala nemek kaka mu tiyemaneeŋ. Hidi yadi Wapum’walaŋ mede yeniŋa yeniŋkiliti eŋ munte mede yeniŋa yabudokoune Bepaŋ’walaŋ gigitmede gineŋ bediyaneeŋ.
Me bomboŋgi eŋ tipilapilaye heki’walaŋ mede
Tipilapilaye heki, hidi kwet diniŋ me bomboŋgihiye gikiŋgoŋ tiyemiŋa Kilistodok timiiŋ undugoŋ aditok maaŋ gikiŋgoŋ tiyemiŋa welehikdi mede tiloloŋ tiyemaneeŋ.

Hidi me bomboŋgihiye dauhik foloŋ kwanai tikamakamaŋe tubune bomboŋgihiyedi haniutumbadok nadiŋa mu taneeŋ. Indi Kilisto’walaŋ tipilapilaye, unduŋ yoŋa, Bepaŋdi talik yoguk u welehikdi nadilodaaŋ takaliyaneeŋ.
Metamdok nadiŋa moŋ, Wapumdok nadiŋa kwanaihik haŋindanit mokit taneeŋ.
Hidi agaŋ nadiiŋ. Nebek niŋ adi tipilapilaye-me be me bomboŋgi hatiŋila nemenemek kedem tihatibaak adi yadi Wapumdi tuwaŋiŋ wendok tuwot mimbaak.

Kaŋ kibi me bomboŋgi heki, hidi maaŋ undugoŋ, tipilapilayehiye momooŋgoŋ tiyemaneeŋ, tiŋa kisaŋ mu yenintoŋa yehitubu-kadakayaneeŋ. Tiŋa indiŋ nadiyaneeŋ: Me tipilapilaye tilak be me bomboŋgi, hidi’walaŋ Wapumhik adi kubugoŋ, kunum gineŋ hatilak. Adi yadi wooŋgaliŋ buŋagaliŋ mu tilak. Ala titiŋnik wondok tuwot hinek kibikoŋnik nimbaak.
Memik hebiniŋ hatiiŋ
Yodapmaŋdok indiŋ yobe. Wapum’walaŋkade wooŋ galiune saŋiniŋŋiŋ wapumdi hidi’walaŋkade meŋeŋa hehitubu-kilitiune saŋiniŋhinit hatiyaneeŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ bohom eŋ kweletalak eŋ mik diniŋ bomboŋ moŋgola yohoneeŋ hatiŋa Sadaŋ’walaŋ tikamanda be halamut u kakiyondaaŋ kelekufali fafaŋeŋ yakaneeŋ.

Hidi agaŋ nadiiŋ. Indi yadi memik foloohik gomnit adut mindobu mu tiyam. Moŋ. Kaulidoko wapum eŋ mik molo, nai indidegoŋ mambip hatak wondiniŋ munabuli fafaŋehi, yabap moihi kadakahi hamap gineŋ hatiiŋ, adi memik tinimiiŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ tebe bohom eŋ kweletalak eŋ mik diniŋ bomboŋ hogohogok moŋgola behatiŋa mik nai gineŋ fafaŋeeŋ, kiŋgineŋ yalune memik hekiyeŋ moŋ tikaŋ bihabuŋa momoyaneeŋ.
Mik bomboŋ moŋgo hatidok
Hidi adi indiŋ tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ. Mede folooŋ hinekdi kiyegelephik tubune youkilitiyaneeŋ, eŋ hatihati didimeniŋdi muhaulehik tubune mukaneeŋ,
eŋ kulema diniŋ Mede Momooŋ tiulidokooŋ behatiyaneeŋ, kaŋ wondi kayohik diniŋ namokop tubune dahiune foune yalikilitiiŋ unduŋ tiluwaak.
Tiŋa daŋiniŋ wapum hinek adi nadisukilitidi kweletalakhik tubune helemahelemaŋ kwehene-tiŋalooŋ kameyalune kadakaniŋ molom diniŋ tebe mahik mikitdi siŋgalalapneeŋ mayaneeŋ.
Tiŋa niŋ kuluŋ fafaŋeniŋ, wou “Bepaŋdi nihitubu-kedebaguk” u mokoyaneeŋ eŋ Munabuli’walaaniŋ bohom mikit Bepaŋ ne’walaŋ medeŋiŋ hinek u kamehatiyaneeŋ.

Hidi nai tuwolit Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli’walaŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ Wapum youdihinit nemek mebimebidok nadisuŋa nimbulabulaye tiŋa ninadiyaneeŋ. Tiŋa hatiliweliweŋ mu taneeŋ, eŋ nadinadiŋila kikakuwat tiŋa hatiyaneeŋ, tiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ metam hogohogok yokwet noli gineŋ itowiiŋ aditok maaŋ Bepaŋ ninadiyaneeŋ.
Tiŋa nutok maaŋ ninadi hatibune Wapumdi mane tubulodaune Mede Momooŋ hebihat tuguk u nadifo foloŋ loŋgoŋ yohautaluwaat.
Nu wendiniŋ gigit yoyodi yot fafaŋeniŋ gineŋ hali munta mu tiŋa yohautawene tuwot tibaak.
Mede yodapmaŋ
Hatihatine diniŋ mebi eŋ kwanai tihatilat u mu nadineeneŋ ale Tikikusdi wooŋ mede kahat tihamdapmawaak. Adi yadi notnik momooŋ eŋ Wapum’walaŋ tipilapilaye-me mede tiloloŋnit.
Biyagoŋ kuyoŋ, adi indi’walaŋ mede kahat tihamuŋa welemomooŋ tubumintahamdok niŋkulene ulak.
Kaŋ Baŋ Bepaŋ eŋ Wapum Jesu Kilistodi notneye hidi kulema tubumintahamuŋa nadisukilitihik tubukilitiune welesiloŋhinit hatiyaneeŋ.
Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto’walaŋkade wooŋ galihinakaiŋ hidi’walaŋkade siloŋ tobogoŋŋiŋdi hatuwaak.
